changes: All remaining Round 4 user-owned product decisions are resolved.
Twenty-plus duplicate progression is explicitly classified as optional long-term mastery rather than baseline ownership completion.
Playable roster is cats and catfolk; active party size is four.
Launch target is 24 characters and 36 weapons, with a smaller honest Floors 1-10 subset.
First reset free ruby pays the first evolution.
Base rarity remains fixed; evolution and duplicate mastery are separate.
Pity target is 100 draws with featured pickup guarantee at 200 and compatible carryover.
Each active character equips one weapon.
No-ad F2P featured-UR guarantee target is 30-45 days.
Paid acceleration is bounded to monthly 1.5x-2x and high-spend 3x-5x candidate ranges.
Reset receives an original Cat's Tower name and replaces or absorbs Dawn.
nextAuthorizedAction: Consolidated canonical redline across product identity, unbounded tower, reset, ruby, evolution, rarity, duplicate mastery, party, weapons, gacha, monetization, screens, backend trust boundary, and simulation dependencies.
